info.name: Miqaat Core Auth (oidc_mfa_auth)
info.description:
Core authentication service: discovery, Authorization Code + PKCE sign-in with the SSR login and MFA pages, token exchange with **client_secret_basic**, /me, trusted handoff, refused client authentication cases and realm-wide logout.

**Run it:** start the service (`npm start`, :4000) and the Test Console (`npm run console`, :5170), set `MFA_STATIC_OTP=123456` in .env (or put the real code into `mfa_code`), then run the whole collection in the Collection Runner or `npx newman run postman/Miqaat_Core_Auth.postman_collection.json`. Folder 0 registers the client `postman-dev` (or issues it a new secret) and fills `client_id` / `client_secret`.

**Variables:** `its_id` / `password` = the member to sign in (local test data), `acr_values` = aal:2 (MFA) or aal:1, `handoff_target` / `handoff_path` = the app and page to open. For a hosted deployment set `issuer`, `console` and `console_password` (the Test Console password). Development / test environments only.

item.name: 0. Setup - Postman client (Test Console, development)
item.description: Registers the client `postman-dev` through the Test Console registration API (same rules as `npm run client:register`) and stores its client_id / secret in the collection variables. If it already exists, a new secret is issued instead. Skip this folder to use another client: set `client_id`, `client_secret`, `redirect_uri` and `post_logout_redirect_uri` yourself (e.g. rms-admin-dev with the secret from .e2e-rms-admin.txt).

item.name: 2. Sign in - Authorization Code + PKCE (+ MFA)
item.description: Plays the browser: start at /auth, follow Core redirects, post the SSR login and MFA forms, stop at the redirect_uri and take the code. Run the folder (Collection Runner / newman) and the requests chain themselves; clicked one by one, the console log names the next request. The MFA step uses `mfa_code` (default 123456 = MFA_STATIC_OTP; put the real code from the outbox otherwise). `acr_values`: urn:miqaat:aal:2 = password + MFA, urn:miqaat:aal:1 = password only.

item.name: 4. Trusted handoff (this client -> another app of the realm)
item.description: The client backend asks Core for a handoff with client_secret_basic (never sends the ITS ID); the browser (Postman cookie jar = the Core session from folder 2) opens the one-time URL and gets the auto-POST page with the signed assertion. Needs handoff outbound on this client and inbound on the target.
